---
title: "Pedagogical contracts and disclosure"
description: "Clarifying authorised AI uses and documenting student practice."
---

This chapter should provide principles and examples for clearly communicating what uses of AI are allowed, required, discouraged, or prohibited in a given assessment.

## What a contract should state

- the learning objectives;
- authorised and prohibited uses;
- disclosure and citation expectations;
- responsibility for the submitted work;
- consequences of non-compliance.
